boundary: Manual rules and an explicitly chosen conservative representability guard. This is not authenticated controller storage, arithmetic, alarm, or runtime-equivalence evidence.

model.name: exact_binary32_normal_or_zero
model.basis: The documented REAL range and approximate seven significant decimal digits are consistent with binary32. Consistency does not prove the controller representation or rounding behavior.
model.literal_parsing: Decimal text is converted to an exact rational before any float conversion.
model.arithmetic: Exact rational intermediate results are checked after every operation. Values are stored as Python floats only when they equal their binary32 encoding exactly.
model.rounding: Values requiring any rounding are rejected. The model does not choose a controller rounding mode or emulate general REAL arithmetic.
model.underflow: Magnitudes below the manual's printed 1.175494E-38 threshold become positive zero. The nearby interval below the minimum normal binary32 value is rejected.
model.limits: Magnitudes above the manual's printed 3.4028236E+38 limit raise overflow. Remaining ambiguous binary32 boundary cases are rejected.
model.signed_zero: Not modeled; zero is normalized to positive zero.
model.square_root: Input is checked with the existing REAL guard first. The reduced rational numerator and denominator must both be perfect squares; their exact root must pass the same REAL guard. No host floating-point square root or tolerance is used.
model.trigonometry: Explicit rational-period/finite-table exact results after existing REAL input checks; see trig_semantics.json. No host trig/libm.
model.fixed_decimal_formatting: CNV_REAL_STR reuses checked exact REAL values and rational scaling for 0..254 fractional digits. The scaled value must be integral; no decimal rounding is used. The explicit precision resource bound and caller-capacity overflow policy are described in conversion_semantics.json.

rules.documented: SQRT(x) accepts a REAL argument, returns its positive square root as REAL and aborts for negative x.
rules.implemented: Nonnegative exact REAL inputs and exact INTEGER/BYTE/SHORT promotions. An exact rational root is computed from checked integer square roots of the reduced numerator and denominator, then validated for normal binary32 or permitted zero.
rules.restriction: Irrational roots are blocked with a source-located KarelRuntimeError before destination assignment. Arguments requiring REAL rounding are rejected even when their mathematical root would be exact. Negative representable inputs raise a domain error. Existing underflow normalization runs first, so a tiny negative value normalized to zero produces zero; this policy is not a controller observation. SQRT in CONST remains blocked by the restricted constant evaluator. KAREL abort/task/alarm behavior is not modeled.

rules.implemented: REAL variables, constants, arrays, parameters and function results; unary signs; numeric +, -, *, / and comparisons for the exact subset.
rules.restriction: Rounding-dependent literals fail conversion with E_REAL_LITERAL. Dynamic rounding-dependent results fail with KarelRuntimeError before destination assignment. No REAL DIV, MOD, AND, OR or NOT.

rules.implemented: Checked scalar promotion on assignment, mixed numeric operations, REAL returns and REAL arguments. INTEGER variable and element arguments to REAL parameters are always independent value temporaries.
rules.restriction: Promotion needing rounding is rejected. No array-wide INTEGER-to-REAL conversion. REAL-to-INTEGER assignment requires an explicit conversion built-in.

rules.implemented: INTEGER inputs return INTEGER; exact REAL inputs return REAL.
rules.restriction: Existing INTEGER overflow checks and REAL exactness guards apply.

rules.implemented: Returns the nearest INTEGER, with half ties away from zero. Checks the documented input interval -2147483648 through 2147483646.
rules.restriction: Input REAL exactness is checked before rounding; ordinary Python round is not used.

rules.implemented: Removes the fractional part toward zero. Checks the documented input interval -2147483648 through 2147483583.
rules.restriction: Input REAL exactness is checked before conversion.

python_references.rule: isqrt computes the floor of an exact nonnegative integer square root. Squaring the candidate verifies a perfect square without floating-point root rounding.
The f format uses IEEE 754 binary32 independently of host floating-point format; used only as a representability guard.
Exact rational representation and arithmetic, including Decimal and float inputs.
Exact decimal construction from source text before representability testing.

unresolved: Controller REAL storage representation and rounding mode are not authenticated by these checks.
General rounded REAL arithmetic and conversion remain blocked, including literals such as 0.1.
General SQRT rounding, negative underflow domain order and controller abort/task/alarm behavior remain unverified.
Near-underflow boundary, signed zero and exact alarm/task behavior need controller observations.
Signed INTEGER MOD behavior remains blocked pending discriminating controls.

vector_update.boundary: Checked initialized VECTOR arithmetic, scaling/division, equality, cross/dot products; POSITION transforms and general rounding remain unsupported.

trig_update.boundary: SIN/COS/TAN/ASIN/ACOS accept only explicit exact degree/input subsets. General rounding, ATAN2/EXP/LN and controller behavior remain unsupported.

atan2_update.boundary: KAREL (x,y) order, exact axes and positive diagonal only; other positive bearings and all negative coordinates are guarded. No general ATAN2 range/rounding or controller behavior.

manual: FANUC KAREL Reference Manual, MARRC75KR07091E Rev N
